notes: Breakout pins (ST, Z, Y, X, GND, VDD) are plugged into breadboard columns 4-9 in row j; each jumper wire goes into the same column in a different row of the same bank, as drawn. Arduino analog pins A0-A5 map to ST, Z, Y, X, GND, VDD respectively.

In the image the top half of the breadboard is labelled rows j-f, so it was treated as catalogue bank 'b'. Exact rows and columns are approximate from the picture; only the column strip matters electrically.
A4 is driven LOW as ground and A5 HIGH as 5V power by the sketch (digital pins 18/19), so no connection to the Arduino 5V or GND pins is made.
The ADXL3xx breakout is mapped to the catalogue adxl335 type; its VCC port is used for the board's VDD pin.
The wire colours for the green, gray and black wires were read from the circuit image.
